title: Tallest Refined Axe
body:
"It’s just a joke."

Description

The highest refined axe could be purchased for three dollars during April Fool's Day in 2023.



Trivia

·When purchasing it during April Fool's Day in 2023, it quickly flew away in the direction of the sun after paying, after all, it is just a joke.

·Someone claims that the axe cannot be picked up.
